refutation_criterion_verbatim: A DR-STD-MAP mapping-table row citing a national EN-ISO adoption of a standard with proven live edition churn is left edition-unspecified AND flagged integrity_gap=false, while structurally identical rows for the SAME underlying ISO standard are flagged integrity_gap=true -- an internally inconsistent risk representation the table's own gap-flag-consistency methodology (established by DR-STD-MAP fire-2) exists to prevent.

violations.reason: Row cites 'DIN EN ISO 9227' with NO edition/year while carrying integrity_gap=false, yet live evidence (fetched this fire) proves this exact standard underwent edition churn including a full withdrawal-and-replace cycle since the row's own snapshot_date. Structurally identical rows for the same underlying ISO 9227 standard (UNE-EN ISO 9227, NP EN ISO 9227, CSN EN ISO 9227) are flagged integrity_gap=true in this same table -- an unprincipled inconsistency the DR-STD-MAP fire-2 gap-flag-consistency methodology exists to catch, extended here to a class of row fire-2 did not examine.
